situation: 동네 빵집. 빵을 받아 들고 그냥 돌아서는 막내를 엄마가 붙잡는다.
npc: NPC: Spanish baker in his 40s, round friendly face, flour-dusted forearms, white apron over a rolled-sleeve shirt, standing behind a wooden counter of bread.
punchline: 아빠는 자기한테는 그런 말 안 하더라고 중얼거린다
style: 1990s Japanese TV anime cel look, hand-painted flat matte color fills, no gradients, no rim light, no glossy highlights. Uniform dark warm-brown ink outlines of even thin weight, never pure black. Rounded simplified shapes, small simple facial features, gentle exaggerated expressions. Shadows are single flat tones only. Simple background art with few details. Static TV-anime framing. Slight paper grain. 9:16 vertical, 1080x1920.
palette: warm cream #FFFBF2, terracotta #C44720, soft peach #F6E2D6, warm sand #EADCCB, muted teal #007C99, mustard #8B6500, warm brown ink #2E2018.
negative: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, glossy skin, cinematic lighting, depth of field, lens flare, hyperdetailed, extra fingers, deformed hands, watermark, logo, western cartoon style, moe anime style, sexualized, heavy shadows, saturated primary colors

shots.shotDescription: Wide vertical shot of a small neighbourhood bakery interior, wooden shelves of bread loaves, warm morning light through the window. The baker leans over the counter handing a paper-wrapped baguette down to HIJO. MADRE waits a step behind.
shots.motionPrompt: Slow push in toward the counter. The baker extends the baguette. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Medium two-shot. HIJO has already turned away, hugging the baguette, halfway to the door. MADRE has caught the back of his t-shirt with two fingers and stopped him, eyebrows raised, not angry, just waiting.
shots.motionPrompt: Static shot. HIJO jerks to a stop. MADRE raises her eyebrows once. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Close-up of MADRE looking straight at camera, speaking slowly and clearly with a small warm smile, one hand resting on her chest. Blurred bakery shelves behind her. Wide empty space in the lower third for a caption.
shots.motionPrompt: Static shot. MADRE's hand rests on her chest and her mouth opens clearly. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Same close-up of MADRE, now spreading both hands wide in a 'that's all' gesture, mouth slightly open mid-explanation. Same blurred bakery. Wide empty space in the lower third for a caption.
shots.motionPrompt: Static shot. MADRE spreads both hands once. Background static.

note.ko: muchas를 앞에 붙이면 muchas gracias — 더 정중해집니다

shots.shotDescription: Close-up of HIJO turning back toward the counter, baguette clutched to his chest, chin lifted, mouth wide open, cheeks pink. Simple blurred bakery shelves behind him.
shots.motionPrompt: Slight push in. HIJO turns his head back and his mouth opens wide. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Medium shot of the baker beaming, both flour-dusted hands raised in delight, already reaching for a small pastry to add to the bag. Warm bakery shelves behind him.
shots.motionPrompt: Slight push in. The baker raises both hands and reaches for a pastry. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Wide shot outside the bakery door. HIJO holds up a free pastry in triumph. MADRE looks pleased. HIJA is already eating half of it. PADRE stands at the edge of frame holding all the shopping bags, staring flatly at the camera.
shots.motionPrompt: Static shot. HIJO lifts the pastry higher. PADRE does not move at all. Background static.

shots.shotDescription: Simple flat cream card background with a soft paper grain and a thin terracotta border, a small hand-drawn bread loaf illustration in the upper area, large empty centre area reserved for typography. No people.
shots.motionPrompt: Static shot. The bread loaf illustration bobs almost imperceptibly. Nothing else moves.

ko.title: 이 한마디에 빵이 하나 더 나옵니다 | 스페인 회화 따라가기 #4
ko.description:
여행 중 가장 많이 쓰게 될 단어 1위. Gracias. (그라시아스)

앞에 muchas를 붙이면 muchas gracias, 훨씬 정중하게 들립니다. 거절할 때도 No, gracias 라고 하면 부드러워져요.

스페인 가족의 실제 대화를 그대로 따라가면서 익히는 시리즈입니다. 단어·회화 연습은 앱에서 이어서 하실 수 있습니다.
ko.pinnedComment: De nada 는 천만에요. 이 두 개가 세트입니다. 다음 편은 만원 지하철이에요 🙌
